proof_body:
by
  intro a b c
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hc : 0 ≤ c := by simpa using h 0
    rcases lt_trichotomy a 0 with hneg | rfl | hpos
    · exfalso
      have hq : 0 ≤ (c + 1) / (-a) := div_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
      have hs := Real.sq_sqrt hq
      generalize Real.sqrt ((c + 1) / (-a)) = t at hs
      have h1 := h t
      have h2 := h (-t)
      have h3 : a * t ^ 2 = -(c + 1) := by
        rw [hs]
        field_simp [hneg.ne]
      nlinarith
    · left
      refine ⟨rfl, ?_, hc⟩
      by_contra hb
      have h1 := h (-(c + 1) / b)
      have e : (0 : ℝ) * (-(c + 1) / b) ^ 2 + b * (-(c + 1) / b) + c = -1 := by
        field_simp
        ring
      linarith
    · right
      refine ⟨hpos, ?_⟩
      have h4 := h (-b / (2 * a))
      have e : 4 * a * (a * (-b / (2 * a)) ^ 2 + b * (-b / (2 * a)) + c) = -(b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c) := by
        field_simp
        ring
      have h5 := mul_nonneg (by positivity : 0 ≤ 4 * a) h4
      linarith
  · rintro (⟨rfl, rfl, hc⟩ | ⟨hpos, hD⟩) x
    · simpa using hc
    · have e : 4 * a * (a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c) = (2 * a * x + b) ^ 2 - (b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c) := by ring
      have h1 : 0 ≤ 4 * a * (a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c) := by
        rw [e]
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (2 * a * x + b)]
      by_contra hn
      push_neg at hn
      have h2 := mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg (by positivity : 0 < 4 * a) hn
      linarith
